Install: `uv tool install miseenplace-cli` (commands: `miseenplace`, `mep`).

`mep` now keeps itself up to date: it checks PyPI hourly in the background from any shell, including cron and agent shells, and upgrades uv tool and pipx installs on its own.

## Fixes

- `mep update` no longer reports an upgrade that did not happen. It refreshes uv's package index and confirms the installed version before saying "upgraded".
- Auto-update works without a terminal and finds uv or pipx even with cron's minimal PATH. A failed upgrade backs off for 24 hours, a lock stops overlapping upgrades, and the "is available" notice appears only when mep cannot upgrade itself or the upgrade failed.

Opt out with `MISEENPLACE_DISABLE_AUTOUPDATE=1` or `auto_update = false` in the config.

Full list of changes: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/ankitkpandey1/miseenplace/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
